description: 한국 여행 안내·관광 통계 (Korea Basics): Answer one question from one Korea Basics page: a rule (K-ETA, duty-free allowance, prohibited goods, medication, tax refund, cash declaration, driving, layover tours and more), a guide (airport arrival, getting around, tourist passes, public holidays), or a travel tool card (plugs, tipping, transit cards, exchange rate, medicine sold at convenience stores). Returns the direct answer, the date it was last checked, and the page URL. Pass `about` with the thing asked (for example tobacco, alcohol, a medicine ingredient) to get up to three matching lines from the page's tables. For rules that depend on the passport, use get_korea_trip_guide with the country instead. The full tables and the official link for applying are on the page.

about.description: Optional. The thing asked about, e.g. "tobacco", "alcohol", "zolpidem", "layover".

id.description: The topic id from search_korea_basics or get_korea_basics_overview (e.g. "k-eta", "customs-allowance", "currency-declaration", "transit-tour", "plug-card"), or its name in plain words (e.g. "duty free", "cash declaration", "layover", "tipping"). If unsure, call search_korea_basics first.

name: get_korea_topic
title: One rule or guide, summarized
